name: SectionHeader
intent: Title (+ optional description) on the left, actions on the right — the heading that sits above a page section, settings pane, or band of tiles. Use this rather than an ad-hoc `h2` + `p` pair so every section reads at the same size and spacing.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line under the title. Omit for a bare heading above a band of tiles.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned slot for the section's actions (buttons, links, search).

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level rendered. Defaults to `h2`; use `h1` when the section owns the page.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) for page sections, `sm` for a heading above a row of tiles.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use SectionHeader to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing throughout your application.
SectionHeader works well for arranging related content, creating responsive layouts, and maintaining visual consistency. Use it to group related elements and establish clear content boundaries.
